result.note: Tested the duration and stated priorities of the RAKSHA defence diplomacy roadmap unveiled in September 2026.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, Rajnath Singh unveiled a defence diplomacy roadmap called RAKSHA. Consider the following statements about it:
items: Arms exports are among its stated priorities.
It envisages a first-responder role for India in the Indian Ocean.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. RAKSHA is a ten-year roadmap whose priorities include arms exports and a first-responder role in the Indian Ocean. It also prioritises security partnerships and joint exercises.
questions.source: Rajnath Singh unveiled RAKSHA, a ten-year defence diplomacy roadmap, prioritising security partnerships, joint exercises, arms exports, and a first-responder role in the Indian Ocean.
